COLLABORATION AGREEMENT: "SLOW WATER" PODCAST

This Collaboration Agreement is made between Lena Park, Marcus Webb and Priya Nair (the "Contributors").

Background

The Contributors jointly produce a weekly audio series called "Slow Water" (the "Podcast") and wish to record how income from the Podcast will be handled.

1. Commencement

1.1 This Agreement starts on April 15, 2026 and continues until terminated by any Contributor on thirty (30) days' written notice.

2. Roles

2.1 Lena Park hosts each episode and is responsible for booking guests.

2.2 Marcus Webb edits, mixes and publishes each episode.

2.3 Priya Nair manages sponsorships and the Podcast's listener membership program.

3. Income

3.1 "Podcast Income" means sponsorship, membership and advertising income received by the Podcast.

3.2 Podcast Income is shared net of payment processor fees, which are deducted before any amount is divided.

3.3 Podcast Income shall be divided among the Contributors in proportions to be agreed by the Contributors in writing.

3.4 Until those proportions are agreed, Podcast Income will be held in the Podcast's account and no Contributor may withdraw it.

4. Expenses

4.1 Recording equipment bought for the Podcast remains owned by the Contributor who paid for it.

5. Ending the Agreement

5.1 On termination, any Podcast Income held in the Podcast's account will be divided in the proportions agreed under clause 3.3.

Signed:
Lena Park
Marcus Webb
Priya Nair
